menu.title: Android Automotive Settings
menu.home_config_desc: Choose which lights and locks to show in your car's Home screen.
menu.geofence_desc: Choose up to 3 gates or garage doors to monitor upon arrival and departure.
menu.climate_desc: Configure which sensors to consider for indoor and outdoor temperatures.
menu.debug_desc: Manage debug logging and diagnostic options.
menu.guide_desc: Learn how to configure, pair, and use the app on your car.

climate.title: Thermometers & Climate
climate.subtitle: Define whether each sensor measures indoor or outdoor temperature.
climate.notice_info: Sensors excluded from climate on Homey are automatically ignored. Here you can specify which sensors measure indoor or outdoor temperature for your car.

debug.title: Debug & Diagnostics
debug.subtitle: Enable verbose diagnostic logs for troubleshooting integration issues.
debug.notice_info: Debug logging produces detailed execution traces. All sensitive credentials, tokens, and GPS coordinates are masked automatically in accordance with security guidelines.
debug.enable_desc: Record verbose operational logs for API requests and device filtering.
debug.download_error: Failed to generate log download URL
debug.confirm_delete_file: Are you sure you want to delete {0}?
debug.confirm_clear_all: Are you sure you want to delete all diagnostic log files?

home_config.title: Home Tab Devices
home_config.subtitle: Select up to 9 devices. If none are selected your Favorite devices will be shown.
home_config.notice_info: Only lights, locks, garage doors, and doorbells are supported. If a smart plug or relay controlling a light is missing, open its device settings in Homey and set 'What's plugged in?' to 'Light'.
home_config.homeyscript_alert: To run Homey Flows from Android Automotive, make sure the official HomeyScript app is installed on your Homey Pro.
home_config.max_reached: You have reached the maximum limit of 9 devices.

geofence.title: Proximity Alert Barriers
geofence.subtitle: Enable alerts for gates or garage doors you want to control. Each active barrier will have a dedicated action button in the vehicle notification.
geofence.notice_info: All barriers are disabled by default. Toggle the switch only for gates or garage doors (maximum 3) you want to control from your car notification.
geofence.max_reached: You can enable a maximum of 3 barriers for vehicle notifications.
geofence.no_barriers: No gates, garage doors, or locks found.

guide.title: User Guide
guide.subtitle: Information about app architecture, initial login procedure, and system requirements.
guide.companion_desc: This Homey application acts as a companion for the main app installed on your car's infotainment system. It securely connects your smart home to your vehicle, synchronizes your preferences, and allows you to control lights, locks, and barriers directly from the car's display.
guide.store_desc: You can download the primary car app for Android Automotive directly from the built-in Google Play Store on your compatible vehicle (Volvo, Polestar, Renault, etc.):
guide.login_step1_title: Enter your Homey ID on the car display
guide.login_step1_desc: When launching the car app, enter your Homey Pro ID to initiate the connection session.
guide.login_step2_title: Scan the QR code with your smartphone
guide.login_step2_desc: A unique QR code will appear on the car display: scan it with your phone camera to open the authorization page.
guide.login_step3_desc: Sign in with your Athom account and authorize the requested access permissions.
guide.login_step4_desc: Once finished on your smartphone, the car app will finalize pairing within seconds and automatically load your devices, barriers, and preferences.
guide.platform_alert: This application is natively designed for Android Automotive OS (built into the vehicle infotainment with Google built-in) and is not compatible with Android Auto (smartphone projection).
guide.flows_desc: To trigger and run your Advanced Flows and Standard Flows from your car display, the official HomeyScript app must be installed and active on your Homey Pro.
